name: Defrost LSWUSDC reentrancy
summary: LSWUSDC computed deposit shares from its temporarily reduced assets during an ERC-3156 flash loan and allowed deposit() from the borrower callback. The callback therefore minted excess shares before flashLoan() restored the principal through a second accounting deposit, letting the attacker redeem more USDC than supplied.
notes: LSWUSDC is a direct contract whose runtime is identical at deployment and immediately before the exploit. Its runtime contains no SELFDESTRUCT, and the exploit trace executes flashLoan(), deposit(), and redeem() directly without delegating LSWUSDC execution.

The exploit receipt gives the attacker cluster a net 173,637.629135 USDC after all LSWUSDC and Trader Joe flash-loan principal and fees are repaid. Transfers between the attacker EOA and helper are internal to the cluster.
